title: CausalOps Causal Ground Truth Specification
description: Formal specification of available experimental ground truth, establishing rigid boundaries between permitted validation use and strictly prohibited model input usage.

ground_truth_distinction.intervention_ground_truth: Empirical knowledge of which service, parameter, and timestamp was directly manipulated by the experiment runner (e.g. do(inventory-db.db_latency = 1600ms at t=5s)). Known with 100% certainty from the execution harness.
ground_truth_distinction.causal_graph_ground_truth: The complete network of true directed edges and transfer functions across all 50 variables. Only partially known from system architecture and validated propagation paths; remaining edge weights and delays must be inferred or verified.

ground_truth_fields.allowed_evaluation_usage: Experiment tracking, indexing, grouping, and linking across split partitions (train/val/test)
ground_truth_fields.prohibited_training_usage: Must not be used as an input feature or categorical predictor

ground_truth_fields.meaning: The exact microservice targeted by deliberate fault injection (or None for NO_FAULT)
ground_truth_fields.allowed_evaluation_usage: Target ground truth for calculating Root Cause Attribution Accuracy (Top-1, Top-2), Precision, Recall, and ROC-AUC of candidate causal ranking
ground_truth_fields.prohibited_training_usage: STRICTLY FORBIDDEN from entering the causal discovery input matrix, feature engineering pipeline, or graph learning adjacency

ground_truth_fields.meaning: The specific chaos injection archetype: DB_LATENCY, SERVICE_LATENCY, NETWORK_LATENCY, ERROR_RATE, SERVICE_FAILURE, or NO_FAULT
ground_truth_fields.allowed_evaluation_usage: Stratified subgroup evaluation of causal effect estimation error and failure mode attribution across fault mechanisms
ground_truth_fields.prohibited_training_usage: STRICTLY FORBIDDEN from entering causal model inputs or conditioning sets during unsupervised/semi-supervised discovery

ground_truth_fields.meaning: Dictionary containing the exact injected magnitude (e.g. {'latencyMs': 1200} or {'errorRate': 30})
ground_truth_fields.allowed_evaluation_usage: Ground truth treatment magnitude for calculating Average Treatment Effect (ATE) estimation error: |estimated_effect - parameter_value|
ground_truth_fields.prohibited_training_usage: STRICTLY FORBIDDEN from entering the discovery model. The model must infer the magnitude of perturbation from observed telemetry changes alone.

ground_truth_fields.meaning: Exact UTC ISO-8601 timestamps marking the active injection interval
ground_truth_fields.allowed_evaluation_usage: Evaluating temporal delay estimation and inflection point detection. Defining pre-fault baseline [0, t_start), active fault [t_start, t_end), and post-fault recovery [t_end, T]
ground_truth_fields.prohibited_training_usage: STRICTLY FORBIDDEN from providing artificial step-change indicators or change-point flags to the model

ground_truth_fields.meaning: Canonical root cause label identical to fault_target (or None for controls)
ground_truth_fields.prohibited_training_usage: STRICTLY FORBIDDEN from model training or discovery

ground_truth_fields.meaning: List of services expected to experience degradation based on static call graph reachability
ground_truth_fields.allowed_evaluation_usage: Evaluating propagation pathway recall and identifying unexpected anomalies or cascading failures
ground_truth_fields.prohibited_training_usage: Must not be used to hardcode model outputs or bypass inference

ground_truth_fields.meaning: Predictions generated by Phase 1 and Phase 2 baseline models
ground_truth_fields.allowed_evaluation_usage: Comparative baseline benchmarking to demonstrate value added by causal inference over associative ML
ground_truth_fields.prohibited_training_usage: Must not be fed as input features into causal discovery or SCM fitting

control_experiment_ground_truth.label: NO_FAULT
control_experiment_ground_truth.ground_truth_state: All services operate at nominal baseline without exogenous intervention
control_experiment_ground_truth.allowed_evaluation_usage: False-Positive Incident Rate, Null Causal Effect Validation (verifying that estimated treatment effect E[do(X=fault)] - E[do(X=normal)] is statistically indistinguishable from zero on controls)
control_experiment_ground_truth.prohibited_training_usage: Must not be used to bias prior probabilities of incident existence
